decision: Renumber TQP milestones so TQP-01 through TQP-46 are the ground-up execution sequence rather than domain-grouped catalog identifiers.
reason: The former stable identifiers forced the human roadmap to jump backward and forward numerically, obscuring the actual dependency sequence and current work.
alternatives: retain domain-grouped identifiers and maintain a separate execution plan
add a second display-only sequence beside the TQP identifiers
continue physically reordering sections while leaving non-sequential identifiers
qualified_scope: identifier migration only; milestone behavior, evidence status, and claim scope are unchanged
downstream_impact: All TQP references, reports, fixtures, validators, blockers, decisions, and documentation use revision 5 identifiers; the active work is TQP-18, TQP-19, and TQP-20.
